name: spacepal
title: Spacepal
description: Switch macOS Spaces by name, jump back to your last Space and send windows between Spaces with Spacepal.
author: Halberd

commands.name: switch-space
commands.title: Switch Space
commands.description: Search your Spaces by name, note or app and switch.

commands.name: move-window
commands.title: Move Window to Space
commands.description: Send the front window to another Space.

commands.name: last-space
commands.title: Back to Last Space
commands.description: Return to the Space you were on before.

commands.name: show-overview
commands.title: Show Space Overview
commands.description: Open Spacepal's overview of every Space.
